Following up from our billing review: Acme Software's AWS Marketplace consumption for April appears to have been invoiced twice across two linked listings (acme-main and acme-eu). I've attached the raw export (AWS_Marketplace_Invoice_May2028.csv) with line-item IDs that show the duplication and the corresponding order IDs.

Attachment: AWS_Marketplace_Invoice_May2028.csv (CSV, 48KB)

- Redwood confirms primary merchant entity for Acme (legal/finance)
- Redwood provides invoice-level reconciliation for the duplicated lines (csv + one-line summary)
- We issue a marketplace adjustment once both sides sign off (timeline: 5-7 business days)

Can you confirm ownership and next steps?

Team — summary and next steps (internal). This is our action plan to close the duplicate billing and make the customer whole.

Summary: AWS and GCP both identified duplicated lines for Acme in April. AWS provided CSV export; GCP provided a formal adjustment notice. Both marketplaces will issue credits but need Redwood to: (A) confirm the merchant entity entitled to credit, (B) produce a reconciled invoice-level mapping, and (C) confirm GL/tax treatment so finance can post the incoming credits correctly.

Assigned owners and immediate deliverables:
- Vanessa: produce MutualActionPlan_Redwood-Acme.xlsx with invoice -> duplicated_line -> suggested_credit columns and share with Acme. (Due: 2028-05-08 EOD)
- Laura (Finance): confirm GL account and whether we need to create an internal credit memo to Acme before marketplace adjustment is applied. Provide tax treatment notes. (Due: 2028-05-06 EOD — please escalate if delayed)
- Marcus: confirm with AWS that their final adjustment will reference our MAP and that they can hold processing until MAP sign-off if needed. (Ongoing)
- Marissa (Legal): review MAP and confirm acceptance language — flag any indemnity or unusual terms. (Due: 2028-05-08 EOD)

Customer communication: I'll send the MAP to Acme and ask them to sign acceptance. Once Acme signs, we'll instruct AWS/GCP to proceed with credits. We will not accept marketplace credits that route to the wrong merchant entity without a signed acceptance.

Attachments: MutualActionPlan_Redwood-Acme.xlsx (XLSX, 34KB)

If anyone hits blockers, call me. I'd prefer a single reconciliation call next week with Acme + AWS + GCP rather than multiple asynchronous threads.

Thanks,
